title: Assessing the long-term efficiency of the MULESL system: a sustainable solution for wastewater treatment and agricultural water reuse
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1316-1327
DOI: 10.1039/D6VA00047A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sofiane El Barkaoui, Marco De Sanctis, Sapia Murgolo, Giuseppe Mascolo, Claudio Di Iaconi
In light of escalating concerns surrounding contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) and the demand for sustainable water reuse, this study evaluates the long-term performance of the MULESL (MUch LEss SLudge) system in treating municipal wastewater for agricultural reuse.
